items.title: Institutions are Piling Into Bitcoin ETFs, Pushing Holdings to a Record
items.description: Bitcoin Magazine Institutions are Piling Into Bitcoin ETFs, Pushing Holdings to a Record Galaxy Research says 13F filers added 49,229 BTC through U.S. spot bitcoin ETPs in Q3, lifting institutional holdings to a record 356,491 BTC as Wells Fargo became the largest holder. This post Institutions are Piling Into Bitcoin ETFs, Pushing Holdings to a Record first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .

items.title: Bitcoin’s Last Line of Defense Is $58K
items.description: ▶ Bitcoin Magazine Bitcoin’s Last Line of Defense Is $58K Katie Stockton, Founder of Fairlead Strategies, joins BMTV as Bitcoin falls below its 200-week moving average, sitting at about $63,000 per the host. This post Bitcoin’s Last Line of Defense Is $58K first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Patrick Green .

items.title: Swiss Bank Sygnum Says Bitcoin Could Reach New High Near $128,000
items.description: Bitcoin Magazine Swiss Bank Sygnum Says Bitcoin Could Reach New High Near $128,000 The Swiss bank estimates bitcoin could hit a new all-time high near $128,000 and calls the current downturn the shallowest bear market to date, as bitcoin moves into reserve portfolios. This post Swiss Bank Sygnum Says Bitcoin Could Reach New High Near $128,000 first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .
